## Citation

To cite this package in publications, please use:

Betebenner DW (2026). _toOrdinal: Function for Converting Cardinal to Ordinal Numbers by Adding a Language
Specific Ordinal Indicator to the Number._. R package version 1.5-0.0,
<https://centerforassessment.github.io/toOrdinal/>.

A BibTeX entry:

```bibtex
@Manual{,
  title = {{toOrdinal}: Function for Converting Cardinal to Ordinal Numbers by Adding a Language Specific Ordinal Indicator to the Number.},
  author = {Damian W. Betebenner},
  year = {2026},
  note = {R package version 1.5-0.0},
  url = {https://centerforassessment.github.io/toOrdinal/},
}
```
